title: Control 01 - Standard
setup: Place 3 Control markers in the center of the West, Central, and Eastern tiles.
deployment: Both Squads deploy before Turn 1 from the Northern or Southern edge of the battlefield.
special:
A Unit **Controls** a Control marker if:
- It is Adjacent to that marker
- It is not Adjacent to any enemies
- That marker is not Adjacent to any enemies
victory:
At the end of each Turn, Squads score 1 MP for each marker they control.

The Squad with the most MP at the end of Turn 4 wins the Mission.

setup: Place 3 Control markers in the center of the West, Central, and Eastern tiles.
deployment: Both Squads deploy before Turn 1 from the Northern or Southern edge of the battlefield.
special:
A Unit **Controls** a Control marker if:
- It is Adjacent to that marker
- It is not Adjacent to any enemies
- That marker is not Adjacent to any enemies
victory:
At the end Turn 4, Squads score 2 MP for each marker they control.

The Squad with the most MP at the end of Turn 4 wins the Mission.

title: Control 03 - Random Active
setup: Place 3 Control markers in the center of the West, Central, and Eastern tiles.
deployment: Both Squads deploy before Turn 1 from the Northern or Southern edge of the battlefield.
special:
A Unit **Controls** a Control marker if:
- It is Adjacent to that marker
- It is not Adjacent to any enemies
- That marker is not Adjacent to any enemies

At the start of each Turn, the player with the Initiative rolls 1D3 to determine which marker is Active.
victory:
At the end of each Turn, Squads score 1 MP if they control the Active marker. At the end of Turn 4, the Squad in control of the Active marker scores 3 MP instead of 1.

The Squad with the most MP at the end of Turn 4 wins the Mission.

title: Claim 01 - Standard
setup: Place 3 Claim markers in the center of the West, Central, and Eastern tiles.
deployment: Both Squads deploy before Turn 1 from the Northern or Southern edge of the battlefield.
special:
**Mission Action: Claim (2 ACT)**  
A Unit Adjacent to an unclaimed Claim marker may Claim it for 2 ACT. This Unit's Squad scores 1 MP. Once Claimed, a marker remains Claimed until the following Turn. At the start of each Turn, reset all markers to their Unclaimed state.  
 A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemies or if the marker is Adjacent to any enemies.
victory: At the end of Turn 4, the Squad wtih the most MPs wins the mission.

title: Claim 02 - End of Mission
setup: Place 3 Claim markers in the center of the West, Central, and Eastern tiles.
deployment: Both Squads deploy before Turn 1 from the Northern or Southern edge of the battlefield.
special:
**Mission Action: Claim (2 ACT)**  
A Unit Adjacent to a Claim marker may Claim it for 2 ACT. Once Claimed, a marker remains Claimed by this Unit's Squad until an enemy Unit Claims that same marker.  
 A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemies or if the marker is Adjacent to any enemies.
victory: At the end of Turn 4, Squads score 2 MP for each Console that they have Claimed.

title: Claim 03 - Progressive
setup: Place 3 Claim markers in the center of the West, Central, and Eastern tiles.
deployment: Both Squads deploy before Turn 1 from the Northern or Southern edge of the battlefield.
special:
**Mission Action: Claim (2 ACT)**  
A Unit Adjacent to a Claim marker may Claim it for 2 ACT. The Unit's Squad scores 1 MP per Turn (e.g. 1 MP in Turn 1, 2 MP in Turn 2, etc.).  
Once Claimed, a marker remains Claimed by this Unit's Squad until an enemy Unit Claims that same marker.  
 A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemies or if the marker is Adjacent to any enemies.
victory: At the end of Turn 4, the Squad wtih the most MPs wins the mission.
